clue.text: Finally sneezed into dotty detailed handkerchief

indicators.note: de-tailed means having the tail cut off, so the final letter is dropped
finally points to the very end of the word that follows it
going into something means being placed inside it

blocks.note: bananas is slang for crazy or dotty
the last letter of sneezed

explanation.surface: Someone sneezes at last into a spotted, finely patterned hanky.
explanation.walkthrough: BANANAS loses its tail to become BANANA, then D goes in the middle: BAN-D-ANA.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandana is a large patterned handkerchief, often worn knotted around the head or neck.

clue.text: Least open-minded brood about weapon
